parties.respondent: State of Uttar Pradesh and Another

summary: Private complaint alleging forged billing; summons issued against unnamed managerial employees under s.406 IPC; issue: summoning without identifying specific accused; High Court dismissal of s.482 CrPC petition; standard: summons requires prima facie material against named individuals; absence of specific roles/identities in complaint vitiates proceedings; summons quashed due to non-identification of accused persons.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; summoning order and High Court judgment quashed; proceedings against unnamed managerial employees set aside.
